item.title: Cornhole for Hospice raises over $76K
item.description: The third-annual Cornhole for Hospice fundraiser in Chatham-Kent raised $76,574 this past weekend. Presented by title sponsor Glenn Seeds Ltd., Saturday’s event brought players of all skill levels together at the John D. Bradley Convention Centre for a day of friendly competition. After round-robin play, 50 two-person teams advanced to double-elimination brackets. In the best-of-the-best […]

item.title: Food for Thought: Research vital to future of greenhouse sector
item.description: Our greenhouse growers have been traveling to and relying on research from the Netherlands for many years. That country is renowned for the latest technologies for greenhouse facilities. The owners of Leamington-based Biophi want to conduct more research here in Canada, to create a horticulture innovation hub. They want to have an industry-led private research […]

item.title: Council adopts Wheatley action plan
item.description: Wheatley’s ongoing revitalization efforts will continue, thanks to the adoption of a five-year strategy. item.title: Ursuline Lancers top CKSS Golden Hawks in overtime for LKSSAA hockey title
item.description: The Chatham-Kent Golden Hawks and Ursuline Lancers always deliver a classic in the LKSSAA girls hockey AAA final, and this year was no exception.

item.title: Ursuline Lancers set to challenge for OFSAA volleyball berth
